top_concerns: No comparison to standard noisy-label learning methods or equal-size random/coreset/early-stopping baselines; the full-data baseline is weak
Privacy and efficiency claims are asserted with no analysis or measurements
Corollaries I and II are trivial or unrigorous (no assumptions or proof) and untested empirically
Small-scale experiments (ConvNet, CIFAR/Tiny-ImageNet), no seeds or variance, no real-world datasets, mixed results (fails on asymmetric and low noise)
No mechanistic analysis of why distillation denoises; the tail-class claim is only hypothesized
